about_the_game:
This is the Demo for Operation Sour Power

Play a vertical slice of our fast-flowing, rebellious platformer! This demo includes 4–5 minutes of high-speed jetpack platforming, hand-drawn art, and environmental combat that shows off the heart and soul of the full game in development.

Core Features

  • One vertical slice level showcasing platforming & jetpack traversal

  • Early environmental combat: magnets, trampolines, and momentum kills

  • Hand-drawn art from our early prototype

  • ~4–5 minutes of gameplay with room for speedrun practice/feedback

  • A tease of the full game’s tone, humor, and pacing

  • Early audio & visuals (we're still improving!)

What's NOT In The Demo

  • Full campaign (enemies, levels, and interactives)

  • Full soundtrack

  • Cutscenes and story (planned for full game)

This demo was built in just 7 days by a tiny team with big ambition. We're using this slice to rally support, gather feedback, and bring you along for the ride as we build the full Operation Sour Power experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for low-spec systems; runs well on most hardware from the last 10 years.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core processor (2.5 GHz+)
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 750 / Radeon R7 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: For smoothest visuals during intense platforming sequences.

short_description: People called it PEAK. We call it just the beginning. Try the Demo! Operation Sour Power is a rebellious, fast-flowing platformer where you charge, blast, and bounce through a collapsing world run by machines.
